text: Moss says the goblins by the Hollow carry new blades. Not rust: forge iron, all of one make.

by.moss: New blades on the goblins by the Hollow. Same make, every one. Somebody sold them, or somebody lost a cart.
by.corwin: Goblins with matching steel. In my day they fought with what they dug up. Somebody is feeding that Hollow.

note: The goblins near Goblin Hollow carry new forge iron, all of one make.

text: Goblins hit Harrow Farm in the night. They took two of Hamm's people: the girl Maddy and the hired man.

by.pip: They came over the far fence in the dark. Maddy and Tobias are gone. I heard her shout and I... I didn't go out. I didn't go out.
by.hamm: They took my brother's girl and my man out of my own yard. It's on the Guild board. Nobody's taken it down.
by.garrick: Goblins, at Harrow. Two taken. Tobias told me about that fence and I said boars. Write that on my stone.
by.lina: A sad business at Harrow. The Company has written to East Watch; it will see the roads made safe. Hamm's note falls due all the same, of course.
by.board: POSTED: Two taken from Harrow Farm by goblins, a girl of seventeen and a man of thirty. Twelve crowns for word of them. Hamm Harrow. (Nobody has taken the notice.)

note: Goblins raided Harrow Farm on the fifth night and took Maddy and Tobias. Pip says who is missing; Lina says the Company will see the roads safe.

text: The Brightwater Four took their first job. Slimes on the south road. All four came back.

by.edwin: First job done! Six slimes on the south road. Tomorrow, something with legs.
by.rook: Six slimes! One of them bit me. Do slimes bite? This one bit. Look at the arm.
by.fen: Four stitches in Rook and a burn on Edwin's hand. For slimes. I've started a second list.
by.moss: Six slimes. Edwin counted seven. One was a rock.
by.corwin: First job. Four out, four back. I counted. That's all a branch master is for.

note: The Brightwater Four finished their first job and all came back.

text: The council met about choosing a reeve. Nothing's settled, but Lina has been at every door since.

by.lina: The village needs a reeve who can read a contract. I only say what everyone is thinking.
by.elder: They want a reeve. Lina wants to be asked. I want my bench. One of us will be disappointed.
by.osric: A reeve costs a tithe. I asked who pays it. Nobody on the council would look at me.

note: The village council wants to choose a reeve. Lina is asking for votes door to door.

text: They say the bonded rose in the Saltmere pits. Hundreds of them. They say the Company hanged one in ten.

by.board: NOTICE, by order of the Margrave: a disturbance at the Saltmere works has been put down. Trade continues. Rumours to the contrary are idle and will be answered.
by.lina: A little trouble at Saltmere, and it's over. Salt will cost more for a month. I'd buy now.
by.smith: Saltmere. That's where they sent my Orrin. You read it on the board? What else did it say? ...Nothing. It never does.

note: The bonded workers rose at Saltmere. The board calls it a disturbance put down; the tavern says one in ten were hanged.
